questions.prompt: Which graph shows y = (x² - x - 2)/(x - 2)?
questions.prompt_markup: Which graph shows y = (x² - x - 2)/(x - 2)?
questions.grading_note: x² - x - 2 = (x - 2)(x + 1), so y = x + 1 for x ≠ 2: the line with a hole at (2, 3). The factor cancels, so there is no asymptote at x = 2, and x = -1 is a zero, not an excluded value.

Graph B: the line y = x + 1 broken at a dashed vertical asymptote x = 2. Graph C: the line y = x + 1 with an open circle at (-1, 0). Graph D: the complete line y = x + 1 with no open circle.
